candidates.structural_interaction: Metal generating Water same-polarity — precision as natural source of flowing depth
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Artisan: a spring that feeds everything downstream. Your output flows, words, ideas, comfort, care, without visible effort, and people drink from it more than you notice. You nourish by permeating: the right thing said gently, the mood eased, the story that waters a dry week.
candidates.k2_functional: Your expression pours: fluent, warm, endlessly refilled. Writing and talk both come as flow.

k2_domain_readings.Expression: Your expression is the stream itself: writing, conversation, comfort flowing daily. Volume is natural to you, so add channels: publish, record, send. Water that reaches others is what turns gift to harvest.
k2_domain_readings.Enjoyment: You enjoy in gentle currents: long baths, slow music, conversation into the night. Honor these as necessities. A spring that is never let pool goes brackish.
k2_domain_readings.Children: With the young you nourish invisibly: the listening, the softening, the words that raise them without their noticing. They will quote you for life, usually without knowing whom they are quoting.

catalyst.define: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows without forcing. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the mood of a room: whatever you give out moves easily and lands soft, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry.

ledger.line: Expressing comes to you the way walking does. No assembly required.
ledger.scene: The toast you gave with zero notes is the one the couple still quotes. You forgot it by dessert.

ledger.line: What you make leaves people fuller. A feature of everything you produce.
ledger.scene: Friends arrive at your kitchen table wound tight and leave two hours later fed, lighter, and not sure what happened.

ledger.line: Your tempo stays loose where others clench. A temperament, not laziness.
ledger.scene: The flight is cancelled and you are the one at the counter making the agent laugh while everyone gets rebooked.

catalyst.advise: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it to done, not to pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Comfort that never risks anything eventually feeds no one.

friction.define: Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output with no banks. Talent leaks into whatever is nearest: snacks, scrolling, pleasant company, half-made things. Nothing is wrong, exactly. That is the problem. Comfort keeps absorbing the effort your best work was waiting for.

ledger.line: You follow the day’s current instead of steering it. A habit, not an accident.
ledger.scene: The Tuesday you planned to write became errands, a nap, and a show. Nobody chose it, which is the point.

ledger.line: Treating yourself is your answer to most feelings.
ledger.scene: Stress orders dessert, boredom opens the app, sadness books the trip. The card statement reads like a mood diary.

ledger.line: It takes a lot to move you, and less would be better.
ledger.scene: The deadline, the news, the argument all get the same shrug and the same tea, until one Thursday everything lands at once.

friction.advise: A river with no banks is a swamp, even a pleasant one. Give your talent one container: one project, one hour, the same time every day. Let yourself be bothered on purpose by one thing that matters. And make the treat follow the work, never replace it.
